attempted_claim: Let H be the hexagonal (honeycomb) lattice with critical FK-Ising (q=2) isoradial weights, in the strip S_N=[0,2N]x[0,N] with Dobrushin boundary conditions (wired bottom, free top). Let S_N\K be the domain with a connected top-attached obstacle K of diameter d<=N/4 removed, and let p_N and p_N^K be the bottom-to-top vertical crossing probabilities in S_N and S_N\K. Using only a monotone FKG coupling of the two domains and Russo-Seymour-Welsh gluing, with the coupling-failure event contained in a one-arm-type connection to K bounded by the published FK-Ising half-plane one-arm exponent and RSW constants, and without any fermionic-ratio approximate Radon-Nikodym derivative or observable-convergence rate, prove there exist explicit C<infinity and beta=1/4 independent of N,d such that |p_N^K-p_N|<=C*(d/N)^beta for all N and d<=N/4. A complete answer states C, defines the coupling, the failure event, and derives the crossing-gap power law.
decisive_failure: correctness: TARGET headline with floored radius and downgrade algebra verified computationally (ARM_REGIME_OK, trivial/small-N covers, C finite). However Lemma 1 as written claims conditional opening probabilities coincide until touching dB and hence exact agreement outside B for FK q=2. For FK this is false: single-edge conditional given explored history integrates over unexplored region containing K, so graphs G vs G\K give different conditionals at first step; CBC gives domination not equality. The stated TV bound |gap|<=max(mu(F),mu^K(F)) therefore lacks proof; standard disagreement-cluster coupling is not cited/proved. H1 exponent 3/8 uniformity (sup over b.c., centre, isoradial honeycomb) is not literally the published statement: DCHN11/Chelkak-DCH prove uniform RSW and exact exponents on Z^2, Wu gives SLE-derived exponents; 3/8 slack must be derived from exact 1/2 via u^{1/2}<=u^{3/8}, not assumed as black box. Corner m<=6 inclusion F=>half-arm up to c0^{-6} is sketched without proof of geometric containment for quarter-annulus at walls. Lattice d1=max(d,1) flooring correctly repairs d=0 normalization (literal (d/N)^{1/4}=0 would be false for single site). Central coupling gap is material, so correctness FAILS as written.
